_about: The Black Observatory (levels 62-66): acolytes, wisps, stalkers and astrologers answer the great lens, the constructs, sentinels and lens-keepers are elites, Curator Nyx and the Voidglass Warden sub-bosses, and the Eclipse Regent under the Eclipse Crown blots out the stars and bends gravity into wells you must leave.
